The '''blitz''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fangol]] was a battle fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after the Rebels successfully captured the Imperial [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessel]] ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'' and attempted to bring it back to their [[Mortex Sector HQ|headquarters]].
